CITY COUNCIL AGENDA  9:00 AM

Jim Dear, Mayor Pro Tem  Lula Davis-Holmes, Councilmember
Jawane Hilton, Councilmember  Cedric L. Hicks, Councilmember

Donesia L. Gause, City Clerk  Monica Cooper, City Treasurer

  EMERGENCY MEETING
  The Disaster Council determined that an emergency situation exists,
  therefore an emergency meeting is called on Friday, July 10, 2020 at 9:00
  a.m. Pursuant to CMC § 3702, Gov’t Code § 54956.5 and Gov’t Code §
  5795605(a).

“In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a
disability related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this
meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk’s office at
310-952-1720 prior to the meeting.” (Government Code Section 54954.2)
**ORAL COMMUNICATIONS**
The public may address the members of the City Council on any matters within the
jurisdiction of the City Council or on any items on the agenda of the City Council ,
other than closed session matters, prior to any action taken on the agenda.
Because of the threat of COVID-19 (aka the “Coronavirus”) you are urged to take
all appropriate health safety precautions.

DUE TO CORONAVIRUS COVID-19, NO MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WILL BE
ALLOWED INTO THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS DURING CARSON COUNCIL
MEETINGS.

TO FACILITATE PUBLIC PARTICIPATION  OUR  CARSON  CITY  COUNCIL
MEETINGS WILL BE AVAILABLE TO YOU BY:

• Livestream on the City’s website:  The meeting will be conducted live over the
internet via http://ci.carson.ca.us

•  Cable Channel 35 (Spectrum) and Channel 99 (AT&T)

Any members of the public wishing to provide public comment for the items on the

ADJOURNMENT

1.. COVID-19 EMERGENCY UPDATE meeting adjourned at 11:25pm 

City Manager Sharon Landers gave a PowerPoint presentation on COVID Trends

CH spoke about concerns related to PPE's with reopening city hall. 1) Having all employees telecommute 2) Vehicle Cleaning and City Hall Cleaning 3)Inquired about warm water. 

He requested more COVID-19 Trends on Carson; Information about child ratio in park programs. 

Monica City Treasurer spoke about city management provided covid updates to all electeds, including city clerk and city treasurer. In addition, she requested for additional space between the public and employees while working the public counters. 

MPT JD recommended the CM close city hall (all city facilities) to reevaluate - AR moved to call the question, CH seconded. CH withdrew his second. 

On discussion of the motion, MPT JD clarified his motion. When CM close city hall close all city facilities, seconded by JH.

LDH substitute motion direct CM to come back with a plan of action addressing the city's covid cases at next city council meeting, seconded by JH
